title: Old Home Distillers
about: Old Home Distillers is a family farm distillery on historic Campbell Road in Lebanon, Madison County, southeast of Syracuse. Jerry and Marlene Carvell founded it in 2015 in a hundred-year-old stable they converted into a stillhouse, and their sons Aaron and Adam help run it. Everything is made on the farm from New York-grown ingredients, from the corn whiskey that started the business to the bourbons, ryes and gins that followed.
Eden pours five of their spirits. Find them on the spirits list in our menu.
